name: macro
description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
one_liner: An all-in-one work app that bundles email, team chat, documents, tasks, video calls and a customer database into one connected system, so a small team doesn't need five separate subscriptions.
buyer: An operations lead at a 10-20 person startup currently paying for Slack, Notion, Linear and HubSpot separately who wants one bill and one searchable system instead.
business_use_cases: A small startup migrates off Slack+Notion+HubSpot onto it to cut software spend and give their AI agents one unified place to search company knowledge.
An agency uses the built-in CRM and shared inboxes to manage client email and project tasks in the same tool their team already chats in.
A small company uses it as the shared memory layer that lets internal AI agents answer questions by pulling from email, docs and tasks together.

money_ideas.idea: Become a certified implementation partner that migrates small companies off their fragmented tool stack onto it, charging for setup and data migration.
Offer ongoing admin-as-a-service (managing integrations, training staff) for small teams that adopt it but lack an internal ops person.

steal_this: Pick one real friction point your own team has (e.g. email-to-task handoff) and build a one-page case study migrating that single workflow into it, then pitch the migration service to other small teams.
